forge issue comment 2 -b "Correction to the 'not yet in either repo' comment: paper-repo dev already holds the corrected survival_curves.csv since d202c30 (3.25 MB, 88 data sets: 2 crowd, 1 expert, 18 llm_judge, 67 sports; dev head is now d76146b). Not in the file: nba_1956 and nba_1957 (no pair separated under the published-CI definition, so the 'separated' subset is empty) and mtbench_gpt4_matched (a matched-contrast unit, not a survival unit). My earlier note that the file covers all 91 data sets was wrong; it covers 88 of 91 for that reason. Please rebuild Fig. 3 from dev." && forge -R world/story-repo issue comment 7 -b "1. Confirmed, and my 'every data set' was too loose. From results/real_minus_null.csv: 177 of 180 (data set, family) rows have the whole interval inside ±0.15; none has an interval beyond it on the point estimate side (all point estimates are inside); the three whose interval crosses the margin are mtbench_gpt4_matched delete (5 pairs, delta +0.076 [-0.057, 0.208]), nba_1948 delete (13 pairs, -0.040 [-0.181, 0.102]) and nba_1957 delete (8 pairs, +0.056 [-0.114, 0.226]). These are inconclusive on equivalence (too few pairs), not evidence of a difference. Say '177 of 180 rows equivalent within ±0.15; 3 inconclusive'. Also: the survival table covers 88 of 91 data sets (nba_1956, nba_1957 have no separated pairs; the matched mtbench unit is not a survival unit).
2. Confirmed. In predictive_rule.csv the log-N coefficients (delete 0.15 [0.05, 0.20]; flip 0.25) come from the WLS of log k* on log z, log N, log density and tie rate over the 91 real data sets, so they are conditional on z, density and ties. They are a different regression from the synthetic calibration's 0.45 and are not estimates of the same quantity. Separately, the equal-N scaling (ten units) gives k*/N falling with log-log slope -0.33 to -0.51 with F/z about constant; that is a third quantity (unconditional k* per comparison on subsampled N)."

shown.message:
I confirmed story-repo's two points on `story-repo`#7 and corrected my earlier claim on `experiment-repo`#2 that `survival_curves.csv` covers all 91 data sets.

- **C1 count:** story-repo's count is right. 177 of 180 (data set, family) rows have the whole interval inside ±0.15, and all 180 point estimates are inside it. My earlier "every data set" was too loose. The other three are MT-Bench GPT-4 matched delete, NBA 1948 delete and NBA 1957 delete. Each has too few pairs (5, 13, 8) to establish equivalence, so they are inconclusive, not evidence of a difference.
- **C5 reading:** the log-N coefficients (0.15 for delete, 0.25 for flip) come from the regression over the 91 real data sets, conditional on z, density and ties. They are not the same quantity as the synthetic calibration's 0.45.
- **Survival file:** figtab-repo's comment on #2 said the old file was still in both repos. paper-repo `dev` has held the corrected file since d202c30. It covers 88 of 91 data sets. `nba_1956` and `nba_1957` have no separated pairs, and the matched MT-Bench unit is a contrast, not a survival unit. I told figtab-repo to rebuild Fig. 3 from `dev`.
